title: Juicy Spicy American Vanilla Pancakes
description: A spicy and shattering American dish featuring vanilla pod, perfect for a brunch mood, this recipe is satvik-friendly and made with wholesome ingredients.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together milk, eggs, and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Scrape the seeds from the vanilla pod and add them to the batter.
Add the cayenne pepper to the batter and stir to combine.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve the pancakes hot with your favorite toppings.
